claims.text: Notices must be sent to the other Party's address or e-mail address as set out below that Party's signature on the Agreement, unless a different address has been notified under the same provision.

citations.quote: sent to the address or e-mail address of the other Party as set out below its signature of this Agreement, or such other address or email address as shall have been notified to the other Party in accordance with this provision

claims.text: Permitted delivery methods include registered post or equivalent, facsimile, courier, or electronic transmission.

citations.quote: Notices shall be sent by registered post or equivalent, facsimile, courier or by electronic transmission.

claims.text: Notices must be given in writing and in the English language.

citations.quote: Any notice required under this Agreement shall be given in writing, in the English language

claims.text: The actual notice addresses or e-mail addresses are not included in the provided excerpts; they are only referenced as appearing below each Party's signature.

citations.quote: as set out below its signature of this Agreement
